summary: Round 1 spec review of the 2026-11-14 addendum (P9-A1 to P9-A11, Q9-1 to Q9-5), the five new Phase 9 tasks, and print-audit-code-tests.md. No Blocker and no Major finding. Three Nit findings: the unexplained tear-tick offset change, the minor count of the addendum request line, and the v0.1 SHA-256 in the code-test list header. Every check of the batch reproduced: the four D7 seeds give the exact areaPx and bbox of the spec, all six SHA-256 values match, the CSS facts of P9-A6 to P9-A8 match the files, the two nose row ids exist, all 11 code-test rows name real files and real test names, and the fold-test page list and commands fit the shipped scripts.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] spec.md P9-A7: The new `.tear-tick` rule changes `left: -0.2mm` to `left: -0.25mm` and the text gives no reason. The Red case X6 pins the width, the length, and the solid border, but no case pins the offset. Rationale: the implementer must guess whether the offset change is intended or a slip. Fix: after the rule line in P9-A7 add: `The left offset changes from -0.2mm to -0.25mm, so the 0.53 mm band is centred on the perforation line (0.25 mm to the left, 0.28 mm to the right). The X6 case also pins the offset.`

F2 [Nit] spec.md addendum request line: The line says `10 minors (A6, B1, B3, B4, C2, D1, D2, D5, D7, E22, F3)` and names 11 rows. The audit summary counts 10 and leaves E22 out; E22 appears only in its J1 re-check table as a minor. Rationale: a wrong count reaches the PM hand-off. The six open items of P9-A10 are right. Fix: replace the parenthetical with `10 minors in the audit summary (A6, B1, B3, B4, C2, D1, D2, D5, D7, F3); the J1 re-check table also marks E22 as a minor, so 11 rows need Daniel's decision`.

F3 [Nit] print-audit-code-tests.md header: The header names the hand-off as version 0.2 with SHA-256 `2c2638de…faec`. That value is version 0.1. Version 0.2 is `3ba657f39bcfc781da581bff93df6a7245f674df4deac023576f5d52ad0aba81`. Rationale: the file cites the wrong hash for its own source; the PM accepted this fault. Fix: replace `2c2638de…faec` with `3ba657f39bcfc781da581bff93df6a7245f674df4deac023576f5d52ad0aba81`.

paraphrase.proposes: The addendum records the print audit gate and its pass rule as decision P9-A1, and the 11-row code-test list as P9-A2 in print-audit-code-tests.md. It fixes six audit minors for proof-books-r6-v2: D1 swaps the ten picture to ten.jpg through a new line-art fix table, D7 fills the hair of Pat in four week 6 pictures, B1 adds a fold-test PDF, B3 makes the picture frames solid, B4 makes the tear-out ticks 0.5 mm wide, and the nose part of A6 clips two nose pictures. It sends six other minors (A6 rest, C2, D2, D5, E22, F3) to Daniel's proof look, and it names the lane, the order, and the dates of one spec review, one Red, and one Green before the 2026-11-15 20:00 hand-off.
paraphrase.current_system: The print modules build the student book, the readers, the card kit, and the teacher book from the week packages and the Forge picture batch. One function, resolveStorytimePictureFiles(folder, rows, kind), gives the file of each picture row to the readers, the student book, and the card kit after the manifest SHA-256 check. The student book CSS draws the picture frames dashed at 0.6 mm and the reader tear ticks 1 px wide, and the resolver has no repair hook. The pictures, the manifest, and the hashes stay byte equal, and the app media take the color files only.
